title: Settlement statement
caption: platform.settlements.status. CHECKs: paid needs paid_at, payout_reference and net > 0; carried_forward needs net ≤ 0; void needs voided_at and void_reason. The statement page offers exactly the actions of its status.

states.label: draft
states.detail: **Add an adjustment** (reason), **Approve** (step-up, If-Match), **Void draft** (reason). Regenerating the month rebuilds drafts and drops their adjustments.

states.label: approved
states.detail: Net owed to the OTA. **Record the bank transfer** (step-up, If-Match).

states.label: carried_forward
states.detail: Net ≤ 0 carried into a later statement (`carried_to_id`).

states.label: void
states.detail: Lines deleted so the transactions can be settled again.
